notes: Stored edit. Siemens's primary listing is stored by name (w1) or through the national benchmark index it belongs to (w2, a rule over index_constituent_of). The CAC 40 class rule and the CAC 40 being a sub-index of the SBF 120 are firm bridges. The original 'no' answers of q0 and q1 need 'Siemens is not listed on Euronext Paris and is in no French index' (a side fact both of the record's worlds list since 2026-10-31); it is encoded as background that the edit forces out in every world (top-level gives_up). q3 compares two cities, which the record tags fol. Relations once declared in this file are catalogued in RELATIONS.md since 2026-10-30.

background.cac40_rule: index_constituent_of value cac40 ⊑ listed_on value euronext_paris

queries.not_checked: fol: compares two places (same city as the European Central Bank)

fol.notes: One uninterpreted sort. primary_listing and home_exchange are functions (a company has one primary listing, an index one home exchange); 'same city' needs an exchange or a headquarters to stand in one city (firm) and the named cities distinct. As the DL file: Siemens's primary listing stored by name (w1) or as the home exchange of the national benchmark index it belongs to (w2).

kinds.says: Frankfurt and Paris are two different cities; the Frankfurt Stock Exchange and Euronext Paris are two different exchanges.

exchange_cities.says: The Frankfurt Stock Exchange is in Frankfurt, Euronext Paris in Paris.

one_city.says: An exchange stands in one city.
one_city.z3: ForAll([x, c, d], Implies(And(city(c), city(d), located_in(x, c), located_in(x, d)), c == d))

home_exchanges.says: The DAX's home exchange is the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, the CAC 40's Euronext Paris; both are national benchmark indexes.

ecb_frankfurt.says: The European Central Bank is headquartered in Frankfurt. (stored)

stores: ForAll(i, Implies(And(national_benchmark(i), index_constituent_of(siemens, i)), primary_listing(siemens) == home_exchange(i)))

queries.ask: Exists(c, And(city(c), located_in(primary_listing(siemens), c), headquartered_in(ecb) == c))

label_corrections.why: 'Same city' is a join over named individuals: siemens : primary_listing some (located_in some (City and inv(headquartered_in) value ecb)); the 'no' needs one city per exchange and distinct cities. No arithmetic.
